mechanism: Hydrocortisone (a CYP3A4 substrate and moderate inducer) may increase mebendazole metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing mebendazole efficacy, while mebendazole may inhibit CYP3A4 and increase hydrocortisone levels.
action: Monitor clinical response to anthelmintic therapy and consider mebendazole dose adjustment or alternative antiparasitic if treatment failure occurs; assess for signs of corticosteroid excess if using high-dose hydrocortisone.
